race.comment: TIME ANGEL (2) doesn't win out of turn but left a good impression last time out when beaten a head into second over 1000m at Griffith. Should enjoy a good run just off the speed. Leading contender. TA LA MASCA (9) is yet to find the frame in two runs since resuming from a spell, the latest when fourth over 1000m at Wagga after he was prominent at the bend. Should be peaking now and is among the leading chances. JENNI DIVINE (7) five-year-old mare who drops in journey from the latest outing when eighth over 1400m at Gundagai, finishing 5 lengths off the winner. Can contest for a place. SEE YOU THEN (4) finished fourth at her latest appearance over 1000m at Jerilderie. Each-way.
